items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: I've never met him. Oh, he's a very nice guy.

ctx.x: Yeah. She came out and wanted this autograph. You know. Yeah. So naturally he was getting really great treatment and I had this waiter that I needed. But you know, people let things, they build things up too much as well. You know. What kind of fellas were in there?
Roland Kirk. Roland Kirk. I've never met him. Oh, he's a very nice guy. Of course naturally being blonde he has certain feelings. Right, right. Well that was the same way with Al Hibbler.
You know, Al Hibbler and I were great friends and I heard Al Hibbler when he was a kid in Little Rock, Arkansas.
